subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 2 – Lesson 6: English in action (asking the price)
outcomes: I can name things in a shop.
I can ask and answer about prices.
I can act out a shop dialogue politely.

tf.s: We say Excuse me to start talking to the shopkeeper.
tf.why: Yes! Excuse me is a polite way to start.

tf.s: We ask about the price with How much is this …?
tf.why: Right! How much is this jumper?
Well done! OMR is Omani rials.

tf.s: The shopkeeper says: Yes, can I help you?
The last line of the dialogue is Excuse me.
tf.why: Excuse me comes first; Thank you comes last.

tf.s: We say Have you are when we give the money.
We say Thank you at the end of the dialogue.
tf.why: Good! We say thank you at the end.

tf.s: The shopkeeper answers the price with It's 5 rials.
tf.why: Yes, It's 5 rials tells us the price.

tf.s: We ask: How old is this jumper? to find the price.
tf.why: For the price we ask How much is this jumper?

tf.s: A baseball cap is something we eat.
tf.why: A baseball cap is something we wear on our head.

boxes.q: What do you say first to the shopkeeper?

boxes.why: How much asks about the price.
We say Here you are when we give something.
The shopkeeper says Can I help you?
We say thank you at the end.

boxes.q: The handbag is 9 OMR. The shopkeeper says …
Which item do you wear on your feet?
boxes.why: We wear trainers on our feet.

boxes.q: Which item do you carry books in?
boxes.why: We carry books in a backpack.

boxes.q: Who says Can I help you?

hunt.q: The jumper card says 2 OMR. It's …
You wear it on your head

mcq.q: How do we ask about a price?
mcq.why: How much is this? asks about the price.

mcq.q: What does the customer say when giving the money?
mcq.why: Here you are is said when we give something.

mcq.q: Which of these is a shop item from the lesson?
mcq.why: A tracksuit is one of the shop items.

mcq.q: What does the shopkeeper say after Excuse me?
mcq.why: The shopkeeper answers Yes, can I help you?

mcq.q: You want to buy a backpack. What do you ask?
mcq.why: How much is this backpack? asks the price.

mcq.q: The coat costs 8 OMR. What does the shopkeeper say?
mcq.why: The price answer is It's 8 rials.

o: Excuse me. → Yes, can I help you? → How much is this jumper?
How much is this jumper? → Excuse me. → Yes, can I help you?
Thank you. → Excuse me. → How much is this jumper?
Yes, can I help you? → Thank you. → Excuse me.
mcq.why: Excuse me first, then the shopkeeper helps, then we ask the price.

mcq.q: Why do we say Thank you at the end?
mcq.why: Thank you is polite and comes at the end.

mcq.q: The shopkeeper says It's 5 OMR. Which line came just before?
mcq.why: The price answer comes after the question How much …?
The correct line is Here you are.
